_doc: Holdout segment governance metadata. Per build plan v5 A2 + architecture v5 §5. Fields populated after Katie completes A2.1 (manual Klaviyo segment creation, with Devon-approved definition). Validator (validate_state_files.py) accepts 0 as valid non-negative for placeholder values; dashboard State Files panel checks `status` field and surfaces 'A2.1 not yet run' when status='pending_a2_1'.
_handoff_to_katie: When A2.1 is complete in Klaviyo (after Devon signs off on the segment definition): (1) replace klaviyo_segment_id with the real segment id, (2) set established_date to today's ISO date, (3) populate current_sample_size with the live profile count from Klaviyo, (4) flip status from 'pending_a2_1' to 'live'. Then commit + push. The sync-klaviyo-automation-to-dashboards.yml workflow mirrors to dashboards repo automatically. Reassigned 2026-05-08 — original spec listed Devon, but Klaviyo segment-builder work fits Katie's domain. See cgo-logs/runbooks/lifecycle-system-runbook-katie.md 'What's A2.1 and how do I do it?' for the precise checklist.
exclusion_mechanism: auto-lane adds Holdout segment to audiences.excluded on every Klaviyo campaign at creation time (per auto_lane.process_auto_lane_cs, B2b.4)
purpose: Persistent ~5% global holdout for incrementality measurement. Excluded from all marketing sends; receives no campaigns or flow messages. Difference in conversion / revenue between holdout and non-holdout populations measures marketing-attributable lift.

_a2_1_definition._doc: The Klaviyo segment definition Katie creates in A2.1 (with Devon's sign-off on the syntax implementation). Hashes profile id deterministically; ~5% will satisfy holdout_id < 5 with uniform distribution.
_a2_1_definition.name: Holdout — DO NOT MARKET (5% global)
_a2_1_definition.method: Compute custom property holdout_id = int(md5(profile.id).hexdigest(), 16) % 100 for each marketing-eligible profile via Klaviyo API bulk update. Then create segment with condition `properties.holdout_id < 5` and is_active=true.
_a2_1_definition.alternatives: If bulk-property-update is heavy lift, an acceptable v1 substitute is created_at-based bucketing: select profiles where (created_at_unix_seconds % 20) < 1. Distribution is approximately uniform; trade-off is slight bias toward older profiles in the 5% bucket. Document the choice in 'method' field above when you ship.
